<thought>Based on the Diels‑Alder template identified, the target molecule can be retrosynthetically disconnected into a simple diene and a dienophile. The diene corresponds to the SMILES “C=CC=C” and the dienophile corresponds to the SMILES “COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1”. This is the only precursor combination returned by the template.</thought>
<final_answer>[['C=CC=C', 'COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1']]</final_answer>
